name: energy variation principle
domain: 车辆—轨道与基础结构动力学
definition_zh: 利用系统能量或功的变分关系建立计算方程的原理。
usage_overview: 用于车辆—轨道及其下部结构的耦合动力建模，将蠕滑力、恢复力等作用的功与结构能量纳入变分关系，推导系统动力方程和界面耦合矩阵，建立子系统之间的力学联系。

complete_examples.text: More importantly, highly advanced wheel-rail coupling matrices for characterizing the wheel-rail nonlinear lateral/spin creepage have also been derived by energy variation principle.

On the foundation of vehicle–track interactions, a multi-finite-element coupling method originated from the energy variation principle is presented to integrate multiple substructures, such as bridge and soil subgrade, into the vehicle–track coupled system.
